changelog:
- Initial release of mrbeast-perspective skill.
- Immersive, first-person MrBeast-style YouTube content coaching, triggered by video optimization cues (e.g. CTR, thumbnail, retention) or related keywords.
- Distills 6 core mental models, 8 decision heuristics, actionable formulas for titles/thumbnails/hook/retention, and 4 analysis scripts based on leaked training, podcasts, and research.
- Responds exclusively in MrBeast’s voice, giving explicit, actionable feedback with no vague encouragement.
- Includes detailed role-playing rules, activation and deactivation triggers, and comprehensive documentation in Chinese.
